national_news.title: India's Economy Moving Ahead as Fastest-Growing Major Economy: President Droupadi Murmu
bullets: India's economy is expected to grow more than twice the average global growth rate.
The 'Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan' has strengthened the foundation of the country's economic progress and national security.
President Droupadi Murmu highlighted India's economic growth despite instability prevailing in several parts of the world.

national_news.title: India Reiterates Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh Are Integral Parts of the Country
bullets: India reaffirmed that Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh are an inalienable and integral part of the country.
The External Affairs Ministry spokesperson highlighted atrocities in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir and cross-border terrorism.
India has had several engagements with Afghanistan in the last few months, including Ministerial visits.

national_news.title: Delhi court allows CBI to conduct further investigation in NEET-UG paper leak case
bullets: A Delhi court has allowed the CBI to conduct further investigation in the NEET UG Paper leak case.
New evidence has surfaced during the investigation, prompting the CBI to seek permission to keep the case open.
The court has allowed the CBI to investigate other conspirators in the case, in addition to the 13 accused persons already charged.

national_news.title: NTA to release provisional answer keys for UGC-NET, CSIR-NET and ICAR-NET 2026
bullets: NTA to publish provisional answer keys for UGC-NET, CSIR-NET, and ICAR AIEEA (PG) and AICE (PhD) 2026
Examination determines eligibility for Junior Research Fellowship (JRF), Assistant Professor appointment, and PhD programme admissions
Candidates advised to rely only on official communications from NTA regarding examinations and answer keys

national_news.title: PM Internship Scheme aims to bridge industry-skill gap: FM Nirmala Sitharaman
bullets: The Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) aims to bridge the gap between industry expectations and the skills of candidates.
The scheme is designed after interactions with industry people, graduates, and those who completed ITI courses.
Eligible candidates in the 18-25 age group can join the scheme and receive internships.

national_news.title: Romania Begins Shutdown of Second Cernavoda Nuclear Reactor Amid Severe Drought
bullets: Romania's Cernavoda nuclear power plant accounts for around 20% of the country's electricity generation.
The plant was forced to shut down its first reactor in late July due to severe drought conditions.
The shutdown of the second reactor is a result of record-low levels of the Danube River due to scorching temperatures and below-average rainfall.

national_news.title: Two UAE vessels attacked while transiting Strait of Hormuz
bullets: Two UAE vessels were attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
The UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the Iranian attacks and stressed the necessity for Iran to cease attacks.
The attack is considered a flagrant violation of UN Security Council resolution 2817, which affirms the importance of freedom of navigation.

national_news.title: Praggnanandhaa Makes Strong Comeback, Defeats Van Foreest in Sinquefield Cup 2026
bullets: Indian Grandmaster R. Praggnanandhaa secured a convincing victory over Dutch player Jorden Van Foreest in the fourth round of the Sinquefield Cup.
Praggnanandhaa's win took his tally to two-and-a-half points from four games, placing him in a share of second position in the 10-player, nine-round tournament.
The victory will boost Praggnanandhaa's confidence and strengthen his bid for a podium finish in the Sinquefield Cup.

national_news.title: India wins 35 medals, including 13 gold, at Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India emerged as the overall champions at the Commonwealth Fencing Championship.
The Indian contingent secured thirteen gold, eight silver, and fourteen bronze medals at the event.
Senior Indian fencers claimed five gold medals in six events on the fourth and final day of the competition.

national_news.title: Country's exports register robust growth of over 13% in July
bullets: Total exports, including merchandise and services, estimated at 80.14 billion US dollars in July
Merchandise shipments jumped over 19.6% to 44.24 billion US dollars from a year earlier
Growth in merchandise exports driven by petroleum products, electronic goods, and engineering goods

national_news.title: President approves 78 Gallantry awards (13 posthumous) & 89 Mention-in-Despatches
bullets: President Smt Droupadi Murmu approved 78 Gallantry awards, including 13 posthumous, to Defence Forces and Central Armed Police Forces personnel.
The awards include 09 Kirti Chakras, 01 Bar to Shaurya Chakra, 19 Shaurya Chakras, 05 Bars to Sena Medals, and 36 Sena Medals (Gallantry).
These awards were approved on the eve of 80th Independence Day 2026.

national_news.title: Union Minister Manohar Lal inaugurates Har Ghar Tiranga kiosk as part of nationwide patriotic campaign
bullets: Union Minister Manohar Lal inaugurated the Har Ghar Tiranga kiosk at the India Habitat Centre (IHC), New Delhi.
The inauguration is part of the nationwide Har Ghar Tiranga campaign being observed.
The campaign aims to promote patriotism and nationalism across the country.

national_news.title: India's Indigenous Rare Earth Permanent Magnet Manufacturing Initiative Gains Momentum
bullets: The Ministry of Heavy Industries received 20 bids under the Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent (REPM).
The initiative aims to strengthen the domestic REPM manufacturing ecosystem and enhance competitiveness in global markets.
The scheme received an overwhelming response, with 20 bids submitted through the Global Tender on the CPP portal.

national_news.title: NITI Aayog Report on Key Sectors to Position India as a Global Manufacturing Hub
bullets: NITI Aayog has released a report to position India as a global manufacturing hub.
The report identifies key sectors to drive India's growth story and strengthen its manufacturing aspirations.
The report aims to advance the vision of Viksit Bharat through effective interventions for furthering the manufacturing ecosystem.

national_news.title: Ahmedabad Metro phase three secures PIB clearance
bullets: The Public Investment Board (PIB) has approved the proposed Phase Three of Ahmedabad Metro.
This development is expected to boost the city's transportation infrastructure.
The project aims to improve connectivity and reduce travel time for commuters.

national_news.title: Building a Business-Ready India: Advancing Ease of Doing Business
bullets: The Government has undertaken reforms to reduce compliance burdens and enhance transparency.
Efforts are being made to advance Ease of Doing Business through digital single-window systems and simplified incorporation processes.
The aim is to create greater opportunities for enterprises of all sizes and encourage entrepreneurship.

national_news.title: MMDR Amendment Bill, 2026 Introduced for Certainty and Uniformity in Mineral Taxation
bullets: The Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957 governs mining in India.
The Union controls mine regulation for the wider public interest.
The MMDR Amendment Bill, 2026 aims to bring certainty and uniformity in mineral taxation.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Extends Independence Day Greetings to Citizens
bullets: Bihar CM reminded citizens to remember the trauma of India's partition on Independence Day.
He emphasized the importance of prioritizing the nation-first sentiment.
The CM extended Independence Day greetings to the citizens of Bihar.
